caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with a rustic appearance, featuring a seat and backrest made from leather or a similar material, which is reddish-brown in color. The leather is attached to the chair frame with a series of evenly spaced round metal studs. The frame of the chair is rendered in a light brown wood with visible grain texture. The armrests are thick and straight, ending in rounded scroll shapes. The front stretcher between the legs below the seat has a decorative wavy cut-out pattern, and the overall construction suggests sturdiness. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white with no additional objects or details present, focusing attention on the chair itself. There is a small signature and text at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Arm Chair (Ecclesiastical)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
